messages.text:
"Create a playable 2.5D stickman game called Moving treadmill. Set it in a chalkboard olympics environment with side-on movement, layered scenery, depth, shadows and a smooth tracking camera. Control one leg to stay balanced on an accelerating conveyor with changing obstacles. Use comical ragdoll physics with articulated joints, gravity, inertia, collision detection and believable contact with surfaces. Do not replace the physical challenge with automatic running or perfect animations. Build a olympic tournament mode with clear objectives, measurable results and immediate retries. Make the difficulty easy to learn, hard to master. Provide large touch controls suitable for phones and equivalent keyboard controls for computers. Show the controlled body part in a contrasting colour. Include a start screen, playable tutorial, live score, attempt counter, pause, restart and results screen. Award points for completing the event, accurate timing and controlled movement. Falls and missed landings should be funny but fair. Keep all characters inside the playable area and reset safely when they leave it. Use original stickman characters, responsive layouts and lightweight effects. Make every button functional and every event playable without external assets. Show a personal best after every attempt. Keep restart times short. Include a slow motion replay of successful moves. Make the tutorial playable. Show clear contact shadows beneath the athlete. Use readable score displays. Add dust.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2.5D stickman “Moving treadmill” game with a chalkboard Olympics theme and tournament-style events.

## Requirements
- Side-on movement, conveyor acceleration, changing obstacles, physical ragdoll-style balance, and manual controls.
- Three playable tournament heats, a playable tutorial, retries, pause, restart, results, personal best, and successful-move slow-motion replay.
- Large touch controls and keyboard equivalents, contrasting gold controlled leg, readable HUD, dust, contact shadows, and responsive layouts.
- Lightweight, original, asset-free implementation.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a single standalone `index.html` using Canvas 2D and inline CSS/JavaScript.
- Used localStorage for the personal best.
- Added direct lean, hop, pause, restart, tutorial, and tournament interactions.
- Assumed a 3-heat format with 15-second practice and progressively harder heat durations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the full start screen, tutorial screen, tournament HUD, heat progress, controls, pause state, results screen, and personal-best display.
- Added articulated stickman physics, collisions, balance wobble, belt motion, hurdles/chalk obstacles, dust, shadows, and responsive mobile sizing.
- Added keyboard and touch controls, clean landing scoring, fall penalties, score bonuses, and replay snapshots.
- Installed Chromium and inspected the app through Playwright with desktop and mobile screenshots.

### Active
- Visual and gameplay validation may need further playthrough testing.

### Blocked
- No current implementation blocker.
- Browser console only reports a harmless favicon 404.

## Next Move
1. Perform an end-to-end playthrough of tutorial and all tournament heats.
2. Test touch controls and pause/restart/result transitions on mobile viewport.
3. Tune fall/landing physics and verify every result action advances correctly.
4. Remove or add a favicon to eliminate the remaining 404 console entry if desired.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/moving-treadmill.jpg`: Latest Playwright viewport screenshot.

## Important Context
- The app is self-contained and served at `http://localhost:3002` during validation.
- Controls: A/D or arrows lean, Space/ArrowUp/W hop, P/Escape pause, R restart.
- Personal best key: `mt-best`.
- The results screen action logic distinguishes tutorial, normal heat, and tournament completion through `modeBeforeResult`.
